decision.explanation: The sources explicitly identify three distinct artists associated with the title 'With a Little Help from My Friends' in different contexts: 1) 'the Beatles' performed the original song (D1S1, D1S3); 2) 'Joe Cocker' performed a famous cover version and released a debut album with this title (D1S6, D4S1, D4S4); 3) 'Lu Elliott' released a jazz album with this title (D7S5). 'Ringo Starr' and 'Billy Shears' are rejected because the text identifies Starr as the intended vocalist for the Beatles' version and Billy Shears as a character name, not the primary artist of the work itself. 'The Grease Band' is a backing group, not the lead artist. Other proposals (Lennon, McCartney, etc.) are songwriters, not the performing artists associated with the specific recordings/albums mentioned in the query context.
